Less Fragmentation. More Scale.

Triffecta

·23rd October 2026

More retailers. More brands. More SKUs. More campaigns. For most retail media teams, every new opportunity also means more log-ins, more set-up and more spreadsheets.

That is not a strategy problem. It is an operating problem. And it is one we have built Triffecta to solve.

Where most teams are today

If you run retail media for a brand or an agency, this will look familiar:

  • Separate log-ins and workflows for every retail media network
  • The same campaign built again and again: per brand, per SKU, per retailer
  • Performance checked campaign by campaign, console by console
  • Reporting stitched together from CSV and XLS exports, with no consistent cross-retailer view

The result is repetitive set-up, slow decisions and a resource bill that grows every time you add a retailer. Your best people spend their week moving data around rather than improving performance.

What changes with Triffecta

Triffecta is the operating layer that sits across your retail media estate. It is not another dashboard. It is where the work gets done.

  • One login. Create, replicate and manage campaigns across connected networks from one place

  • Build once, deploy many. Duplicate a winning campaign to another retailer without rebuilding it in each portal

  • Unified data and customised reporting by retailer, category, SKU, trading period and promotion

  • AI and day-parting that align content, media and spend with peak customer opportunity, with your team in control

This is live. Brands and agencies are running campaigns through Triffecta today, with UK grocery networks including Sainsbury’s and Morrisons connected, and more integrations on the roadmap.

Scale without the growth tax

Retail media should reward growth, not penalise it. Triffecta is a fixed monthly fee, not a percentage of your spend. And because set-up, replication and reporting happen in one place, more activity does not need proportionately more people, agency hours or admin.

More retailers and campaigns should not mean more admin.

Less fragmentation. Lower resource load. Simpler reporting. That is retail media, made easy.

Want to see your own campaigns in one view? Book a demo with the Triffecta team.
